271906359_d7d875b5.text: In contrast, little is known about the role of retinal inputs in the development of vLGN.

271906359_c81f28b6.text: Through both activity- and morphogen-dependent mechanisms, retinal inputs play important roles in the development of dLGN, including the refinement of retinal projections, morphological development of thalamocortical relay cells (TRCs), timing of corticogeniculate innervation, and recruitment and distribution of inhibitory interneurons.
